title: Nuevo Laredo Offers Free Shingles Vaccine for Residents 50 and Older
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo is offering free shingles vaccinations Nov. 17, 18 and 20 at the Centro Cívico, with 2,000 doses set aside for 1,000 residents age 50 and older, the municipal government announced.
content:
Nuevo Laredo is offering free vaccinations against shingles, known as herpes zóster or culebrilla, on Tuesday, Nov. 17, Wednesday, Nov. 18, and Friday, Nov. 20, according to the municipal government.

The campaign runs from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Centro Cívico, at Reynosa Street #1544 in the Ojo Caliente neighborhood, and is aimed at residents age 50 and older and people who meet medical criteria because of a comorbidity, according to the announcement.

The city acquired 2,000 doses, enough to protect 1,000 people with the two-dose schedule, according to the municipal government. Each dose costs more than 4,000 pesos in the private sector, so completing the schedule privately would cost more than 8,000 pesos per person.

The shingles vaccine is not part of Mexico's universal free vaccination schedule, so access usually depends on the private market, according to local reporting. The city said Nuevo Laredo is the first municipality in the country to offer the vaccine free of charge.

The campaign was announced by the municipal government led by Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal as part of its prevention and health care access efforts, according to the announcement.

Sources: La Voz NLD, Nov. 17, 2026; Noticiero de Victoria, Nov. 17, 2026; CML Noticias, Nov. 17, 2026.
